review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Only odd checkerboard cells have positive instability, so pillars with even corner can be omitted without losing benefit. Every useful L connects one even-row/even-column stable cell through an odd corner to one odd-row/odd-column stable cell. These endpoints are necessarily in perpendicular directions, so every such path is exactly a legal orientation. Capacity one on stable cells and split corner nodes enforces no overlap. Min-cost flow with cost -instability selects at most M disjoint pillars; stop when the best residual augmentation is nonnegative. Reverse arcs permit globally optimal rearrangements, not a greedy independent choice of high-valued corners. Collapsed cells are entirely absent from the network.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
